accepted_additions.expected_answer: Each gets board, bag, Merchant, 10 stations, 5 coins, 7 markers and colored Farmer/Boatman/Craftsman/Trader. Starting Followers on Market, Merchant in Orléans, markers at first spaces of six Character Tracks and Development Track; stations/coins in front of player. Youngest starts.
accepted_additions.novelty: Initial availability and board/personal placement

accepted_additions.expected_answer: 13 Citizens on marked main/Deed board spaces, remaining Citizen aside. Technology supply on board; neutral Followers sorted by profession in buildings. Places sorted I/II. Shuffle goods face down, put one face up per Road/Waterway goods space, sort leftovers face up to Goods Market.
accepted_additions.novelty: Shared setup, market versus map destinations

accepted_additions.expected_answer: 3 players remove 2 each Farmer/Boatman/Craftsman/Trader, 3 each Knight/Scholar/Monk, 6 random goods; leave 4 spaces empty. 2 players remove 4 each first four types, 6 each last three, 12 random goods; leave 3/4 spaces empty. Remove unused colors starting Followers.
accepted_additions.novelty: Player-count-dependent supply and map setup

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Farm House Boatman+Craftsman; Village Farmer+Boatman+Craftsman; University Farmer+Craftsman+Trader; Castle Farmer+Boatman+Trader; Monastery Scholar+Trader.

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Ship Farmer+Boatman+Knight; Wagon Farmer+Trader+Knight; Guildhall Farmer+Craftsman+Knight.

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Scriptorium Knight+Scholar. Town Hall one or two neutral Followers of any profession, but no colored starting Followers; Deed destinations must match exact depicted professions.

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Yes: draw four and recover two assigned Followers into Market (subject to space). One recovery per declined draw in Phase3; cannot transfer directly between Action Spaces.

accepted_additions.expected_answer: May inspect bag at any time for number/types, then shuffle so draws cannot be chosen deliberately.
accepted_additions.novelty: Private bag inspection and randomized draws

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Hour Glass, Census, Followers, Planning, Actions, Event, Start Player. Token to player left. Start planning simultaneously; announce completion; if needed clockwise from Start Player; payments same order. Coins paid to/received from common supply.
accepted_additions.novelty: Phase sequence, simultaneous planning and payment priority

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Complete that entire round, including actions and event; then final Trading Station Citizen award and scoring.

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Use Farmers Track marker position, not physical tiles currently owned/in bag. Unique track leader gains 1 coin.
accepted_additions.novelty: Track state versus current Follower ownership

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Coins equal to current Development Status, not raw position counted as Development Points.
accepted_additions.novelty: Income event value basis

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Pay 2 coins, one per complete group of three goods regardless of type; shortage triggers torture for missing coins.
accepted_additions.novelty: Taxes complete-group rounding and payment failure

accepted_additions.expected_answer: 4 coins, one per built Trading Station; unbuilt stations do not count.
accepted_additions.novelty: Trading Day built-only income

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Hayrick Farmer→grain; Cheese Factory two Farmers→cheese; Winery Farmer+Trader→wine; Wool Manufacturer Boatman+Trader→wool; Tailor Shop Scholar+Trader→brocade. Each takes one from Goods Market, and cannot be used if that type absent.
accepted_additions.novelty: Five base production Places, costs and local exhaustion

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Shipping Line Boatman:1 Development Point. Brewery Monk:2 coins. Windmill two Craftsmen:2 coins plus1 Development Point. Library Knight+Scholar:2 Development Points.

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Any one Character can activate. Spend1–3 coins for equal Development spaces; two coins moves2. Cannot spend zero or four.
accepted_additions.novelty: Flexible activation with bounded voluntary payment

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Trader+Knight. Merchant moves along one Road to adjacent town and collects one good if available.

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Scholar+Craftsman; gives Technology under usual constraints. First must replace Farmer, which Laboratory lacks, so first cannot go there. Later can replace Scholar or Craftsman there if no existing Technology (not Monk; max one per Place).

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Farmer activates. Draw3 bag Followers, choose2, immediately place on matching Action Spaces; none on Bathhouse. Third drawn and activating Farmer return to bag.
accepted_additions.novelty: Original-edition Bathhouse immediate placement and destinations

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Place the one immediately; return other two and activating Follower to bag. If none fit, place none and return all three plus activating Follower. Never place Bathhouse draws on Bathhouse.
accepted_additions.novelty: Bathhouse insufficient-placement branch

accepted_additions.expected_answer: May execute on a later own action turn this round: Bathhouse places immediately, and full activation allows action during current/future Action Phase; no extra Planning Phase required. Cannot act after passing.
accepted_additions.novelty: Bathhouse changes activation during Actions rather than Planning

accepted_additions.expected_answer: A Monk activates. During Event Phase return Monk to bag instead of suffering current negative event such as Harvest, Taxes or Plague.
accepted_additions.novelty: Sacristy event-phase consumption/protection

accepted_additions.expected_answer: No. Pilgrimage forbids Monk recruitment in Phase5 Actions. Sacristy substitutes for negative effects during Phase6 Event and cannot cancel that earlier prohibition.
accepted_additions.novelty: Sacristy protection timing versus exceptional Pilgrimage timing

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Ongoing ability, no activation: Boatmen replace Craftsmen, Traders and Farmers only. Does not permit Boatmen to replace Knights, Scholars or Monks.
source_references: PDF p.23 Herb Garden tile; lines506–513
accepted_additions.novelty: Herb Garden exact substitution set

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Ongoing no-activation ability: Scholars may replace other Character types except Monks. Cannot replace Monk.
accepted_additions.novelty: School ongoing substitution and Monk exception

accepted_additions.expected_answer: No: Deeds always require exact depicted types regardless of substitution abilities or route through Town Hall/Tower.
accepted_additions.novelty: Global exact-type exception overrides acquired substitution/routing abilities

accepted_additions.expected_answer: Adds2 Market spaces; put1/2 drawn Followers there in Phase3. In Planning move one/both onto Action Spaces, or during Actions send one/both directly to matching Deed spaces in a single action. Cannot send colored starting Followers to Deeds.
